findings.title: push leaves the database with no active EQL configuration when the INSERT is rejected
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Confirmed non-transactional deactivate-then-insert in push.ts combined with cast_as values the EQL CHECK constraint rejects.

findings.title: push silently discards pending/encrypting EQL configurations and overrides EQL's config lifecycle
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The unscoped UPDATE at push.ts:33-35 deactivates pending/encrypting rows, bypassing EQL's config lifecycle.

findings.title: install applies an unpinned 'latest' EQL bundle that may not match the installed client library
findings.label: valid
findings.note: installer/index.ts:3-6 and install.ts:243-244 fetch releases/latest SQL with no pin or checksum, which can mismatch the client version.

findings.title: --supabase grants broad privileges on the eql_v2 schema to anon and authenticated roles
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same confirmed broad ALL grants to anon/authenticated in grantSupabasePermissions.
